title: Textured Serigraph
description: Un style d'illustration minimaliste à couleurs plates imitant la sérigraphie vintage et le risographe. Il présente des blocs de couleurs audacieux sans dégradés, des ombres portées nettes, des bords organiques irréguliers et une texture de grain de papier uniforme omniprésente.
description_en: A minimalist, flat-color illustration style mimicking vintage screen printing and risograph techniques. It features bold, unshaded color blocks, stark cast shadows, organic ragged edges, and a pervasive, uniform paper grain texture.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration minimaliste à couleurs plates imitant la sérigraphie vintage et le risographe. Il présente des blocs de couleurs audacieux sans dégradés, des ombres portées nettes, des bords organiques irréguliers et une texture de grain de papier uniforme omniprésente.
prompt:
Vintage screen print illustration, risograph flat color blocking, traditional serigraphy style. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The artwork strictly utilizes unshaded, solid color expanses with absolutely no gradients, blending, or soft transitions, relying entirely on the stark juxtaposition of pure hues. Lighting is strictly implied through stark, geometric cast shadows rendered as solid, unmodulated dark shapes, simulating harsh direct sunlight without any ambient occlusion. Employ a highly restricted spot-color palette featuring vibrant {{primary_color}} as the dominant hue, punctuated by bold {{accent_color}} elements and grounded by {{secondary_color}} structural shadows and midtones. The entire composition is unified by a heavy, pervasive paper grain texture and subtle halftone noise, giving a tactile, matte, printed materiality. Subjects and spatial planes are defined entirely by contrasting color boundaries rather than drawn black outlines. Contour edges are intentionally ragged, textured, and slightly imperfect, mimicking organic ink bleed, porous paper absorption, and manual print registration offsets. Depth is achieved through flat, overlapping horizontal bands, simplified silhouettes, and an orthographic spatial approach. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. 

vintage screen print, risograph, serigraphy, flat color blocks, heavy paper grain, ragged edges, unshaded, solid cast shadows, minimalist illustration, limited palette, matte texture, ink bleed, spot color, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Elements move with a slight staggered frame rate mimicking traditional cel animation or stop-motion, keeping color blocks strictly flat.
video.camera: Static or slow linear orthographic panning, maintaining the flat layered depth.
video.temporal_texture: The heavy paper grain and ragged ink-bleed edges must boil subtly over time, maintaining the printed materiality.
video.avoid: Smooth 3D interpolations, gradient lighting shifts, motion blur, and clean vector edges.
